Source and notation check: all ordinary T forms on this leaf have a single cap and stem; C’s repeated bars are not supported by a second horizontal stroke. The hollow-circle and filled-dot forms supply local comparisons. The written empty set is phi. Prose E_epsilon and displayed Ep_epsilon coexist and are preserved. First two small labels read def without an independent accent, while the lower brace label has a separate mark supporting déf.

Layout/scope check of P07: the one continuous transverse note overlaps the frame of neighbouring main text. Inverse rotation maps the apparent blob after forment to the current formula number (6), about original (245,1062), and the alleged T_epsilon after voisinages to the main-text underlined NB, about (269,1351). Those elements are transcribed once in the main text, not duplicated as marginal cancellations. The genuine un at about (31,1973) belongs to the margin, as does the separate plus/plein : T fragment near (52–115,1900–1740), whose attachment remains uncertain.

The source retains the literal word “tubulaires” in the final family paragraph after the earlier inserted replacement coniq. for cancelled tub. The final assertion reads “est la frontière de T_lambda=lambda T dans X”. Both inline map connectors lack a secure arrowhead. The old (6), current (6), and final (8) show overwork; no invented chronological sequence or earlier numeral is supplied. Thin foliation 12 has indeterminate attribution.

Root targeted counterexample, conditional on the cone-action interpretation supplied by root from the preceding page (not independently read by this first reader): take X=([0,1]×{0}) union ({1/2}×[0,1]), T=[0,1]×{0}, Y={(0,0)}, dotted T={(1,0)}, and lambda·(t,0)=(lambda t,0). T is closed in X and contains a neighbourhood of Y; it is the cone on dotted T→Y. At lambda=3/4, T_lambda=[0,3/4]×{0}. Its ambient boundary in X consists of the junction (1/2,0) and the endpoint (3/4,0), whereas lambda dotted T consists only of (3/4,0). Thus the final ambient-frontier assertion fails under these hypotheses. Root confirmed the exact final ink in P10 before this diagnostic was added. The transcription is unchanged.

Refinement of N05: the issue is the distinction between the interior in T and the ambient interior in X. In the counterexample, the junction belongs to the former but not the latter. An additional hypothesis controlling ambient openness of the cone interior would be needed to exclude this obstruction; no general sufficiency theorem is asserted here. This check does not verify the compactness/fundamental-system marginal claim or all preceding cone identities.

Footer scope check: the final lambda meets the physical sheet edge. Completing strip P12 contains only that edge and black scanner background below it; it adds no source letters or indices. No diagram or unrelated drawing occurs on this leaf; the two marginal vertical strokes and the unheaded inline connectors are retained as written symbols.

Root targeted proof check, under the canonical cone/pushout model of the preceding leaf: T is the quotient of Y disjoint-union ([0,1] times dotted T), identifying (0,b) with f(b). For 0<lambda<=1, T_lambda has inverse image Y disjoint-union ([0,lambda] times dotted T), hence is closed by the quotient topology. The circled T_lambda has inverse image Y disjoint-union ([0,lambda[ times dotted T), hence is open. If 0<lambda<1, every point (lambda,b) has arbitrarily close radial points with larger parameter; thus the interior in T of T_lambda is exactly circled T_lambda. At lambda=1 the interior of T in itself is all T, explaining the stated endpoint exception. These arguments use the canonical pushout interpretation, not the literal extra arrowheads in the preceding diagram.

Root targeted proof check, with 0<epsilon<1 and lambda=1-epsilon: the part of the cone away from Y is homeomorphic to ]0,1] times dotted T. Hence E_epsilon=T minus circled T_lambda is [lambda,1] times dotted T, a neighbourhood of dotted T, with frontier in T equal to {lambda} times dotted T. The separately defined dotted Ep includes both endpoint copies; it need not equal that ambient frontier. If Y and dotted T are compact, the defining disjoint union is compact and so is its quotient T. For any open neighbourhood V of Y, its inverse image contains {0} times dotted T; compactness of dotted T and the tube lemma give a uniform delta>0 with [0,delta] times dotted T mapped into V. Thus the scaled T_delta form a neighbourhood basis. Compactness of Y is not needed for this last basis assertion.

Root targeted qualification of the marginal revision fermés to ouverts: with T_epsilon interpreted as the scaled closed subsets defined in the main text, they are not generally open. In the cone on a point, T=[0,1], Y={0}, dotted T={1}, and T_epsilon=[0,epsilon]; for 0<epsilon<1 this is closed and a neighbourhood of Y but not open in T. The circled T_epsilon=[0,epsilon[ are open. The marginal word ouverts is nevertheless retained because its letters and insertion state are visible; the unclear extra fragment plus/plein : T might bear on the intended attachment, which is not imposed here.
